title: N2bReport
description: Payload schema for n2b scan results (JSON reports). Mirrors the JSON produced by `n2b --report=json`. JSONL mode wraps each object with a `type` discriminator ("meta" for the header, "finding" for subsequent lines).

schema_version.description: Schema version, bumped on breaking changes.

root.description: Absolute path of the scanned root.

Compat.description: Bun↔Node compatibility metadata of the host module — Phase 3+. Optional (rétro-compat). Le champ status pilote la sévérité dérivée.

status.description: Statut de couverture Bun du module Node host. full = tout passe, partial = bug-free sur les chemins courants, missing = pas d'équivalent natif.

module.description: Nom du module Node concerné (sans le préfixe node:).

missing_apis.description: Sous-APIs documentées comme non implémentées par Bun. Vide quand status=full.

path.description: Relative path to the scanned root.

changed.description: True if the file content differs from its pre-scan state (only in --fix / --aggressive / --migrate modes).

rule_id.description: Rule identifier — slash-separated category/name (e.g. 'api/fs-readFileSync'). Immutable: consumers parse this.

category.description: Top-level category derived from rule_id prefix.

start_byte.description: Byte offset into the scanned file of the finding start (UTF-8).

end_byte.description: Byte offset into the scanned file of the finding end (UTF-8).

replacement.description: Suggested replacement. Omitted entirely when no replacement is known.

autofix.description: True when the rule can be auto-applied by --fix.

aggressive.description: True when the rule is only applied by --aggressive. Omitted when false/unset.

docs_url.description: Stable Bun (or external) docs URL for this rule.

compat.description: Phase 3+ : statut de compat Bun du module hôte. Présent uniquement sur les findings imports/node-* et api/node-*. Optionnel (rétro-compat schema_version=2).

Context.description: Source context around a finding: up to 3 lines before, the finding's line, up to 3 lines after. Consumed by LLM/IDE integrations.
